{{Quote|Couple of years back, I scammed this gang for a bulk-load of credits. Spent everything to set up a refugee hospital on Alderaan.|Archiban Kimble|<ref name="Best" />}}
A '''criminal gang''' was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], its members sought revenge against the [[Medic/Legends|combat medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] after he scammed the group out of a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for a shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that he never delivered. They kidnapped his former [[Marriage/Legends|fiancé]], [[Prudy]], and Kimble was forced to rescue her with the help of the [[Republic Customs Office]].

==History==
{{Quote|They're not the first gang that contributed to my favorite charity. It's like taking candy from a baby.|Archiban Kimble|<ref name="Best" />}}
[[File:Prudy.png|thumb|left|220px|Prudy was kidnapped by the gang]]
The criminal gang was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], during which its members encountered the [[Medic/Legends|combat medic]] and adventurer [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]].<ref name="Best" /> "Doc Operator," as they knew him,<ref name="Anonymous">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Anonymous}}</ref> offered the gang a shipment of valuable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] but scammed the group out of a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when he failed to deliver the spice. Kimble used the stolen money to set up a [[Prudy's hospital|refugee hospital]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for his [[Marriage/Legends|fiancée]], [[Prudy]], though he later ended their engagement.<ref name="Best" />

However, the gang eventually tracked down its stolen credits and learned of Prudy's [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]]<ref name="Best" /> in [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> The gang held Prudy hostage and attempted to blackmail Kimble into delivering either the spice or the credits, and Kimble's attempt to go undercover for the [[Republic Customs Office]] went sour when he was forced to replace Prudy as the gang's hostage. Fortunately for Kimble, Republic hostage negotiators were eventually able to secure Kimble's release&mdash;but not before the gangsters had burned Prudy's hospital to the ground.<ref name="Best" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gang was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which they are mentioned in the conversation "Best Intentions" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion Kimble, who was also known as Doc. The conversation was originally intended as a full mission in which the player would confront the gang's leader, [[Cazzush]], on Alderaan with Doc, but that version was cut from the game and replaced with the situation involving Republic Customs.<ref name="Best" />
